prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only `application/json` (not also `text/event-stream`), even though SSE isn't needed in JSON mode. Both PRs edit the identical Accept-header validation block in `src/server/webStandardStreamableHttp.ts` (~line 598-614) to stop requiring both media types. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both touch the same lines in the same validation block and can't both land without a merge conflict. #1996 replaces the check with a dedicated `acceptsMediaType()` parser that splits the header on commas, trims/lowercases each media-range, strips `;`-params, and explicitly excludes entries with `q=0` before comparing type/subtype — this correctly handles multi-value Accept headers with parameters and quality values. #2046's fix keeps a plain `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` substring check, which does not parse parameters/q-values and is subject to false-positive substring matches against any media type string containing that literal substring. #1996's approach covers strictly more of the Accept-header grammar with the same one-file diff footprint.
